description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Cost 1 Conviction

Targets 1 ally adjacent to you

The ally leans on you. It regains 1 Focus Point, or, if it has no focus pool, 1 point of whatever renewable pool its own class abilities spend. The point can take it above its usual maximum until the end of the encounter. It must be adjacent — physically. Open to any Oath: Resolve is what your Conviction is called under the Unwritten Oath; under another Oath, spend Conviction as normal.

cinderfall.incomplete: Conviction is Cinderfall's renamed Focus Point pool (every Vow spell carries a 'Focus 1' cost tag). No rule element anywhere in pf2e-source writes to system.resources.focus.value -- confirmed via grep -rl "resources.focus.value" pf2e-source/packs/pf2e returning zero files. Every real rule element touching that path only adjusts .max via ActiveEffectLike mode:"upgrade" (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/clarity-of-focus.json), never .value. Restoring a different creature's resource pool from the caster's own action additionally requires No rule element can set a modifier, apply a condition, or read a value on/from a different creature's own roll or resource from the card holder's own item -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass.
